title: The One-Sided Wonder: Graphing a 3D Möbius Strip in Desmos
description:
The One-Sided Wonder: Graphing a 3D Möbius Strip in Desmos

In this Desmos 3D Masterclass, we explore 3D Wireframe & Mesh Engines using pure multivariable calculus and linear algebra inside the Desmos Graphing Calculator.

📐 Mathematical Architecture:
- Core Formula: X = \left(1 + \frac{v}{2}\cos\frac{u}{2}\right)\cos u, \quad Y = \left(1 + \frac{v}{2}\cos\frac{u}{2}\right)\sin u, \quad Z = \frac{v}{2}\sin\frac{u}{2}
- Concepts: Non-Orientable Topology, Half-Twist Boundary, Surface Parametrization
- Pedagogical Lesson: The Möbius strip is a non-orientable surface with only one boundary and one continuous side. The factor of u/2 in the coordinate equations creates the characteristic half-twist over a complete 2pi revolution.
